compatibility.forwardConvention: Existing -Z forward aligns with detailed cameraForward -Z; detailed assetFront +Z is a distinct asset convention. Apply and receipt mesh-specific transforms once; no automatic axis conversion.
compatibility.eyeHeight: Existing nominal1.69m and detailed default1.65m remain explicit camera parameter variants; seated1.2m is separate. Camera clearance QA is still required; neither value is a device certificate.
compatibility.navigation: Detailed source targets >=1.0m doorway and >=1.2m route are stricter design targets than existing0.9m minimum; existing1.5m turning diameter retained. No accessibility certification inferred.
compatibility.budgets: Detailed desktop750000/mobile120000/XR180000 visible triangle targets do not exceed existing desktop750000/mobile250000/XR350000 limits. Detailed memory budgets are stricter targets; no measured runtime result inferred.
compatibility.eraVariants: Detailed specs add optional eras/variants; existing era identity and scene ID remain canonical for Batch1. Out-of-original-range variants are additive specification intent requiring separate content review.
compatibility.deliverables: Existing complete-scene deliverables remain required. Modular candidate.glb and provenance readiness templates cannot substitute for collision/nav, scene package, LODs, preview pixels or explicit acceptance.
